            "boolean/data-true",

            "float/data-neg",
            "fixed32/data-zero",
            "fixed32/data-max-uint",
            "fixed32/data-min-uint",
            "fixed64/data-zero",
            "fixed64/data-max-uint",
            "fixed64/data-min-uint",
            "sfixed32/data-zero",
            "sfixed32/data-max-int",
            "sfixed32/data-min-int",
            "sfixed64/data-zero",
            "sfixed64/data-max-int",
            "sfixed64/data-min-int",
            "message/data-message",
            "string/data-one",
            "string/data-string",
            "int32/data-zero",
            "int32/data-pos",
            "int32/data-neg",
            "int32/data-min",
            "int32/data-max",
            "int64/data-zero",
            "int64/data-pos",
            "int64/data-neg",
            "int64/data-min",
            "int64/data-max",
            "sint32/data-zero",
            "sint32/data-pos",
            "sint32/data-neg",
            "sint32/data-min",
            "sint32/data-max",
            "sint64/data-zero",
            "sint64/data-pos",
            "sint64/data-neg",
            "sint64/data-min",
            "sint64/data-max",
            "uint32/data-zero",
            "uint32/data-pos",
            "uint32/data-max",
            "uint64/data-zero",
            "uint64/data-pos",
            "repeated/data-one",
        };
        for (const auto& filename : filenames) {

jobs:
  # Building using the github runner environement directly.
  cmake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Check cmake
      run: cmake --version
    - name: Configure
      run: cmake -S. -Bbuild -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_DEPS=ON -DUSE_SCIP=OFF
    - name: Build
      run: cmake --build build --config Release --target all -v
    - name: Test
      run: CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE=1 cmake --build build --config Release --target test -v
    - name: Install
      run: cmake --build build --config Release --target install -v -- DESTDIR=install

void __SYNSetupVolume(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    ASSERTLINE(85, voice);
    voice->attn = (voice->region->attn + __SYNVolumeAttenuation[voice->keyVel]);
}
void __SYNSetupPan(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    ASSERTLINE(98, voice);
    if (voice->midiChannel == 9) {
        voice->pan = voice->art->pan;
    } else {
        voice->pan = voice->synth->controller[voice->midiChannel][10];
    }
}
s32 __SYNGetVoiceInput(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    return (voice->attn + voice->lfoAttn + voice->veAttn) >> 0x10;
}
s32 __SYNGetVoiceFader(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    return (voice->synth->volAttn[voice->midiChannel] + voice->synth->expAttn[voice->midiChannel] + voice->synth->masterVolume) >> 0x10;
}
void __SYNUpdateMix(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    MIXSetInput(voice->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceInput(voice));
    MIXSetAuxA(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->auxAAttn[voice->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetAuxB(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->auxBAttn[voice->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetFader(voice->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceFader(voice));
    if (voice->midiChannel != 9) {
        MIXSetPan(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->controller[voice->midiChannel][10]);
    }
}

void ColourTable::staticCtor()
{
	for(unsigned int i = eMinecraftColour_NOT_SET; i < eMinecraftColour_COUNT; ++i)
	{
		s_colourNamesMap.insert( unordered_map<wstring,eMinecraftColour>::value_type( ColourTableElements[i], (eMinecraftColour)i) );
	}
}
ColourTable::ColourTable(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	loadColoursFromData(pbData, dwLength);
}
ColourTable::ColourTable(ColourTable *defaultColours, PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	// 4J Stu - Default the colours that of the table passed in
	XMemCpy( (void *)m_colourValues, (void *)defaultColours->m_colourValues, sizeof(int) * eMinecraftColour_COUNT);
	loadColoursFromData(pbData, dwLength);
}
void ColourTable::loadColoursFromData(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	byteArray src(pbData, dwLength);
	ByteArrayInputStream bais(src);
	DataInputStream dis(&bais);
	int versionNumber = dis.readInt();
	int coloursCount = dis.readInt();
	for(int i = 0; i < coloursCount; ++i)
	{
		wstring colourId = dis.readUTF();
		int colourValue = dis.readInt();
		setColour(colourId, colourValue);
		AUTO_VAR(it,s_colourNamesMap.find(colourId));
	}
	bais.reset();
}
void ColourTable::setColour(const wstring &colourName, int value)
{
	AUTO_VAR(it,s_colourNamesMap.find(colourName));
	if(it != s_colourNamesMap.end())
	{
		m_colourValues[(int)it->second] = value;
	}
}
void ColourTable::setColour(const wstring &colourName, const wstring &value)
{
	setColour(colourName, _fromHEXString<int>(value));
}
unsigned int ColourTable::getColour(eMinecraftColour id)
{
	return m_colourValues[(int)id];
}

asm void PSMTXReorder(const register Mtx src, register ROMtx dest) {
    psq_l f0, 0(src), 0, 0
    psq_l f2, 16(src), 0, 0
    psq_l f4, 32(src), 0, 0
    psq_l f1, 8(src), 0, 0
    ps_merge00 f6, f0, f2
    psq_l f3, 24(src), 0, 0
    ps_merge01 f12, f4, f0
    psq_l f5, 40(src), 0, 0
    ps_merge11 f7, f2, f4
    psq_st f6, 0(dest), 0, 0
    ps_merge00 f8, f1, f3
    psq_st f12, 8(dest), 0, 0
    ps_merge01 f9, f5, f1
    psq_st f7, 16(dest), 0, 0
    ps_merge11 f10, f3, f5
    psq_st f8, 24(dest), 0, 0
    psq_st f9, 32(dest), 0, 0
    psq_st f10, 40(dest), 0, 0
}
asm void PSMTXROMultVecArray(const register ROMtx m, const register Vec* srcBase, register Vec* dstBase, register u32 count) {
    nofralloc
    stwu r1, -64(r1)

static unsigned long F(unsigned long x, symmetric_key *key)
{
   return (((key->blowfish.S[0][(x>>24)&255] +
            key->blowfish.S[1][(x>>16)&255]) ^
            key->blowfish.S[2][(x>>8)&255]) +
            key->blowfish.S[3][(x>>0)&255]);
}
int blowfish_setup(const unsigned char *key, int keylen, int num_rounds,
                   symmetric_key *skey)
{
   unsigned long x, y, z, A;
   unsigned char B[8];
   _ARGCHK(key != NULL);
   _ARGCHK(skey != NULL);
   /* check key length */
   if (keylen < 8 || keylen > 56) {
      return CRYPT_INVALID_KEYSIZE;
   }
   /* check rounds */
   if (num_rounds != 0 && num_rounds != 16) {
      return CRYPT_INVALID_ROUNDS;
   }   
   /* load in key bytes (Supplied by David Hopwood) */
   for (x = y = 0; x < 18; x++) {
       A = 0;
       for (z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
           A = (A << 8) | (unsigned long) key[y++ % keylen];
       }
       skey->blowfish.K[x] = ORIG_P[x] ^ A;
   }
   /* copy sboxes */
   for (x = 0; x < 4; x++) {
       for (y = 0; y < 256; y++) {
           skey->blowfish.S[x][y] = ORIG_S[x][y];
       }
   }
   /* encrypt K array */
   zeromem(B, 8);
   for (x = 0; x < 18; x += 2) {
       /* encrypt it */
       blowfish_ecb_encrypt(B, B, skey);
       /* copy it */
       LOAD32H(skey->blowfish.K[x], &B[0]);
       LOAD32H(skey->blowfish.K[x+1], &B[4]);
   }
   /* encrypt S array */
   for (x = 0; x < 4; x++) {
       for (y = 0; y < 256; y += 2) {
          /* encrypt it */
          blowfish_ecb_encrypt(B, B, skey);
          /* copy it */
          LOAD32H(skey->blowfish.S[x][y], &B[0]);
          LOAD32H(skey->blowfish.S[x][y+1], &B[4]);
       }
   }
#ifdef CLEAN_STACK
   zeromem(B, sizeof(B));
#endif
   return CRYPT_OK;
}
#ifdef CLEAN_STACK
static void _blowfish_ecb_encrypt(const unsigned char *pt, unsigned char *ct, symmetric_key *key)
#else
void blowfish_ecb_encrypt(const unsigned char *pt, unsigned char *ct, symmetric_key *key)
#endif
{
   unsigned long L, R;
   _ARGCHK(pt != NULL);
   _ARGCHK(ct != NULL);
   _ARGCHK(key != NULL);
   /* load it */
   LOAD32H(L, &pt[0]);
   LOAD32H(R, &pt[4]);
   /* do 16 rounds */
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[0];  R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[1];  L ^= F(R, key);
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[2];  R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[3];  L ^= F(R, key);
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[4];  R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[5];  L ^= F(R, key);
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[6];  R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[7];  L ^= F(R, key);
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[8];  R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[9];  L ^= F(R, key);
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[10]; R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[11]; L ^= F(R, key);
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[12]; R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[13]; L ^= F(R, key);
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[14]; R ^= F(L, key);
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[15]; L ^= F(R, key);
   /* last keying */
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[17];
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[16];
   /* store */
   STORE32H(R, &ct[0]);
   STORE32H(L, &ct[4]);
}
#ifdef CLEAN_STACK
void blowfish_ecb_encrypt(const unsigned char *pt, unsigned char *ct, symmetric_key *key)
{
    _blowfish_ecb_encrypt(pt, ct, key);
    burn_stack(sizeof(unsigned long) * 2);
}
#endif
#ifdef CLEAN_STACK
static void _blowfish_ecb_decrypt(const unsigned char *ct, unsigned char *pt, symmetric_key *key)
#else
void blowfish_ecb_decrypt(const unsigned char *ct, unsigned char *pt, symmetric_key *key)
#endif
{
   unsigned long L, R;
   _ARGCHK(pt != NULL);
   _ARGCHK(ct != NULL);
   _ARGCHK(key != NULL);
   /* load it */
   LOAD32H(R, &ct[0]);
   LOAD32H(L, &ct[4]);
   /* undo last keying */
   R ^= key->blowfish.K[17];
   L ^= key->blowfish.K[16];
   /* do 16 rounds */
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[15];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[14];
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[13];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[12];
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[11];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[10];
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[9];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[8];
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[7];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[6];
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[5];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[4];
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[3];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[2];
   L ^= F(R, key); R ^= key->blowfish.K[1];
   R ^= F(L, key); L ^= key->blowfish.K[0];
   /* store */
   STORE32H(L, &pt[0]);
   STORE32H(R, &pt[4]);
}

    _blowfish_ecb_decrypt(ct, pt, key);
    burn_stack(sizeof(unsigned long) * 2);
}

int blowfish_keysize(int *desired_keysize)
{
   _ARGCHK(desired_keysize != NULL);
   if (*desired_keysize < 8) {
      return CRYPT_INVALID_KEYSIZE;
   } else if (*desired_keysize > 56) {
      *desired_keysize = 56;
   }
   return CRYPT_OK;
}

void RegisterAssetDatabaseBindings(py::module_ &m)
{
    py::class_<AssetDatabase>(m, "AssetDatabase")
        .def(py::init<>())
        .def("initialize", &AssetDatabase::Initialize, py::arg("project_root"),
             "Initialize asset database with project root")
        .def("refresh", &AssetDatabase::Refresh, "Refresh assets by scanning Assets folder")
        .def("import_asset", &AssetDatabase::ImportAsset, py::arg("path"), "Import a single asset")
        .def("delete_asset", &AssetDatabase::DeleteAsset, py::arg("path"), "Delete asset and its meta")
        .def("move_asset", &AssetDatabase::MoveAsset, py::arg("old_path"), py::arg("new_path"),
             "Move/rename asset preserving GUID")
        .def("on_asset_created", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetCreated, py::arg("path"), "File watcher hook: asset created")
        .def("on_asset_modified", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetModified, py::arg("path"), "File watcher hook: asset modified")
        .def("on_asset_deleted", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetDeleted, py::arg("path"), "File watcher hook: asset deleted")
        .def("on_asset_moved", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetMoved, py::arg("old_path"), py::arg("new_path"),
             "File watcher hook: asset moved")
        .def("contains_guid", &AssetDatabase::ContainsGuid, py::arg("guid"), "Check if GUID exists")
        .def("contains_path", &AssetDatabase::ContainsPath, py::arg("path"), "Check if path exists")
        .def("get_guid_from_path", &AssetDatabase::GetGuidFromPath, py::arg("path"), "Get GUID from asset path")
        .def("get_path_from_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetPathFromGuid, py::arg("guid"), "Get asset path from GUID")
        .def("get_meta_by_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByGuid, py::arg("guid"), py::return_value_policy::reference,
             "Get meta by GUID")
        .def("get_meta_by_path", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByPath, py::arg("path"), py::return_value_policy::reference,
             "Get meta by path")
        .def("get_all_guids", &AssetDatabase::GetAllGuids, "Get all GUIDs in database")
        .def("is_asset_path", &AssetDatabase::IsAssetPath, py::arg("path"), "Check if path is in Assets folder")
        .def_property_readonly("project_root", &AssetDatabase::GetProjectRoot, "Project root path")
        .def_property_readonly("assets_root", &AssetDatabase::GetAssetsRoot, "Assets root path");
}

const size_t record_count = sizeof(keys) / sizeof(keys[0]);
std::string strip_commas(const std::string &str) {
  std::string result = str;
  result.erase(std::remove(result.begin(), result.end(), ','), result.end());
  return result;
}
short lookup(const char *key) {
  std::string modifiable_key(key);
  modifiable_key =
      strip_commas(modifiable_key);  // stripping the commas because I exported the item names with them stripped
  size_t left = 0, right = record_count;
  while (left < right) {
    size_t mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
    int cmp = strcmp(keys[mid], modifiable_key.c_str());
    if (cmp == 0) return values[mid];
    if (cmp < 0)
      left = mid + 1;
    else
      right = mid;
  }
  return -1;  // Not found
}

// Test case for skip functionality
TEST_CASE("skip")
{
    SECTION("check that skip skips the right amount of bytes")
    {
        std::vector<std::string> filenames = {
            "boolean/data-true",
            "boolean/data-false",
            "bytes/data-one",
            "bytes/data-string",
            "bytes/data-binary",
            "double/data-zero",
            "double/data-pos",
            "double/data-neg",
            "float/data-zero",
            "float/data-pos",
            "float/data-neg",
            "fixed32/data-zero",
            "fixed32/data-max-uint",
            "fixed32/data-min-uint",
            "fixed64/data-zero",
            "fixed64/data-max-uint",
            "fixed64/data-min-uint",
            "sfixed32/data-zero",
            "sfixed32/data-max-int",
            "sfixed32/data-min-int",
            "sfixed64/data-zero",
            "sfixed64/data-max-int",
            "sfixed64/data-min-int",
            "message/data-message",
            "string/data-one",
            "string/data-string",
            "int32/data-zero",
            "int32/data-pos",
            "int32/data-neg",
            "int32/data-min",
            "int32/data-max",
            "int64/data-zero",
            "int64/data-pos",
            "int64/data-neg",
            "int64/data-min",
            "int64/data-max",
            "sint32/data-zero",
            "sint32/data-pos",
            "sint32/data-neg",
            "sint32/data-min",
            "sint32/data-max",
            "sint64/data-zero",
            "sint64/data-pos",
            "sint64/data-neg",
            "sint64/data-min",
            "sint64/data-max",
            "uint32/data-zero",
            "uint32/data-pos",
            "uint32/data-max",
            "uint64/data-zero",
            "uint64/data-pos",
            "repeated/data-one",
        };

        // Iterate through all test files and verify skip behavior
        for(const auto& filename : filenames)
        {
            std::string buffer = get_file_data(std::string("test/t/") + filename + ".pbf");
            mapbox::util::pbf item(buffer.data(), buffer.size());
            REQUIRE(item.next());
            item.skip();
            REQUIRE(!item);
        }
    }
}

  cmake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Check cmake
      run: cmake --version

    - name: Configure
      run: cmake -S. -Bbuild -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_DEPS=ON -DUSE_SCIP=OFF

    - name: Test

    - name: Install
      run: cmake --build build --config Release --target install -v -- DESTDIR=install

// Setup volume for a voice
void __SYNSetupVolume(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    ASSERTLINE(85, voice);
    voice->attn = (voice->region->attn + __SYNVolumeAttenuation[voice->keyVel]);
}

// Setup panning for a voice
void __SYNSetupPan(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    ASSERTLINE(98, voice);
    if (voice->midiChannel == 9) {
        voice->pan = voice->art->pan;
    } else {
        voice->pan = voice->synth->controller[voice->midiChannel][10];
    }
}

// Get voice input value
s32 __SYNGetVoiceInput(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    return (voice->attn + voice->lfoAttn + voice->veAttn) >> 0x10;
}

// Get voice fader value
s32 __SYNGetVoiceFader(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    return (voice->synth->volAttn[voice->midiChannel] + voice->synth->expAttn[voice->midiChannel] + voice->synth->masterVolume) >> 0x10;
}

// Update mixing parameters for a voice
void __SYNUpdateMix(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    MIXSetInput(voice->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceInput(voice));
    MIXSetAuxA(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->auxAAttn[voice->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetAuxB(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->auxBAttn[voice->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetFader(voice->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceFader(voice));
    if (voice->midiChannel != 9) {
        MIXSetPan(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->controller[voice->midiChannel][10]);
    }
}

// Initialize the static colour name map
void ColourTable::staticCtor()
{
	for(unsigned int i = eMinecraftColour_NOT_SET; i < eMinecraftColour_COUNT; ++i)
	{
		s_colourNamesMap.insert( unordered_map<wstring,eMinecraftColour>::value_type( ColourTableElements[i], (eMinecraftColour)i) );
	}
}

// Constructor with raw data
ColourTable::ColourTable(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	loadColoursFromData(pbData, dwLength);
}

// Constructor with default colours and new data
ColourTable::ColourTable(ColourTable *defaultColours, PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	// 4J Stu - Default the colours that of the table passed in
	XMemCpy( (void *)m_colourValues, (void *)defaultColours->m_colourValues, sizeof(int) * eMinecraftColour_COUNT);
	loadColoursFromData(pbData, dwLength);
}

// Load colours from binary data stream
void ColourTable::loadColoursFromData(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	byteArray src(pbData, dwLength);
	ByteArrayInputStream bais(src);
	DataInputStream dis(&bais);
	int versionNumber = dis.readInt();
	int coloursCount = dis.readInt();

	for(int i = 0; i < coloursCount; ++i)
	{
		wstring colourId = dis.readUTF();
		int colourValue = dis.readInt();
		setColour(colourId, colourValue);
		AUTO_VAR(it,s_colourNamesMap.find(colourId));
	}

	bais.reset();
}

// Set a colour by name and integer value
void ColourTable::setColour(const wstring &colourName, int value)
{
	AUTO_VAR(it,s_colourNamesMap.find(colourName));
	if(it != s_colourNamesMap.end())
	{
		m_colourValues[(int)it->second] = value;
	}
}

// Set a colour by name and hex string
void ColourTable::setColour(const wstring &colourName, const wstring &value)
{
	setColour(colourName, _fromHEXString<int>(value));
}

// Get colour value by enum ID
unsigned int ColourTable::getColour(eMinecraftColour id)
{
	return m_colourValues[(int)id];
}

#include <pybind11/stl.h>

namespace py = pybind11;

namespace infengine
{
    // Register bindings for AssetDatabase class
    void RegisterAssetDatabaseBindings(py::module_ &m)
    {
        py::class_<AssetDatabase>(m, "AssetDatabase")
            .def(py::init<>())
            .def("initialize", &AssetDatabase::Initialize, py::arg("project_root"),
                 "Initialize asset database with project root")
            .def("refresh", &AssetDatabase::Refresh, "Refresh assets by scanning Assets folder")
            .def("import_asset", &AssetDatabase::ImportAsset, py::arg("path"), "Import a single asset")
            .def("delete_asset", &AssetDatabase::DeleteAsset, py::arg("path"), "Delete asset and its meta")
            .def("move_asset", &AssetDatabase::MoveAsset, py::arg("old_path"), py::arg("new_path"),
                 "Move/rename asset preserving GUID")
            .def("on_asset_created", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetCreated, py::arg("path"),
                 "File watcher hook: asset created")
            .def("on_asset_modified", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetModified, py::arg("path"),
                 "File watcher hook: asset modified")
            .def("on_asset_deleted", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetDeleted, py::arg("path"),
                 "File watcher hook: asset deleted")
            .def("on_asset_moved", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetMoved, py::arg("old_path"), py::arg("new_path"),
                 "File watcher hook: asset moved")
            .def("contains_guid", &AssetDatabase::ContainsGuid, py::arg("guid"), "Check if GUID exists")
            .def("contains_path", &AssetDatabase::ContainsPath, py::arg("path"), "Check if path exists")
            .def("get_guid_from_path", &AssetDatabase::GetGuidFromPath, py::arg("path"), "Get GUID from asset path")
            .def("get_path_from_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetPathFromGuid, py::arg("guid"), "Get asset path from GUID")
            .def("get_meta_by_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByGuid, py::arg("guid"),
                 py::return_value_policy::reference, "Get meta by GUID")
            .def("get_meta_by_path", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByPath, py::arg("path"),
                 py::return_value_policy::reference, "Get meta by path")
            .def("get_all_guids", &AssetDatabase::GetAllGuids, "Get all GUIDs in database")
            .def("is_asset_path", &AssetDatabase::IsAssetPath, py::arg("path"), "Check if path is in Assets folder")
            .def_property_readonly("project_root", &AssetDatabase::GetProjectRoot, "Project root path")
            .def_property_readonly("assets_root", &AssetDatabase::GetAssetsRoot, "Assets root path");
    }

// Returns a 4D integer vector (RGB + alpha=255)
Eigen::Vector4i html_color(COLORNAME color) {
  const auto& c = html_color_bytes[static_cast<size_t>(color)];
  return Eigen::Vector4i(c[0], c[1], c[2], 255);
}

// Returns a 4D float vector (normalized RGB + alpha=1.0f)
Eigen::Vector4f html_colorf(COLORNAME color) {
  return html_color(color).cast<float>() / 255.0f;
}

// Returns the array of color names
const std::array<const char*, static_cast<size_t>(COLORNAME::NUM_COLORNAMES)>& html_color_names() {
  return html_color_names_cstr;
}

// Returns just the RGB bytes for a given color
std::array<unsigned char, 3> html_color_value(COLORNAME color) {
  return html_color_bytes[static_cast<size_t>(color)];
}

// Setup volume for a voice using key velocity and region attenuation
void __SYNSetupVolume(SYNVOICE* v) {
    ASSERTLINE(85, v);
    v->attn = (v->region->attn + __SYNVolumeAttenuation[v->keyVel]);
}

// Configure panning based on MIDI channel (channel 9 is percussion)
void __SYNSetupPan(SYNVOICE* v) {
    ASSERTLINE(98, v);
    if (v->midiChannel == 9) {
        v->pan = v->art->pan;
    } else {
        v->pan = v->synth->controller[v->midiChannel][10];
    }
}

// Compute combined attenuation for voice input
s32 __SYNGetVoiceInput(SYNVOICE* v) {
    return (v->attn + v->lfoAttn + v->veAttn) >> 0x10;
}

// Compute fader level from channel and master volume settings
s32 __SYNGetVoiceFader(SYNVOICE* v) {
    return (v->synth->volAttn[v->midiChannel] + v->synth->expAttn[v->midiChannel] + v->synth->masterVolume) >> 0x10;
}

// Update mixing parameters for the voice
void __SYNUpdateMix(SYNVOICE* v) {
    MIXSetInput(v->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceInput(v));
    MIXSetAuxA(v->axvpb, v->synth->auxAAttn[v->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetAuxB(v->axvpb, v->synth->auxBAttn[v->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetFader(v->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceFader(v));
    if (v->midiChannel != 9) {
        MIXSetPan(v->axvpb, v->synth->controller[v->midiChannel][10]);
    }
}

// Initialize the static mapping from string names to enums
void ColourTable::staticCtor()
{
	for (unsigned int idx = eMinecraftColour_NOT_SET; idx < eMinecraftColour_COUNT; ++idx)
	{
		s_colourNamesMap.emplace(ColourTableElements[idx], static_cast<eMinecraftColour>(idx));
	}
}

// Constructor: loads colours from raw data buffer
ColourTable::ColourTable(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	loadColoursFromData(pbData, dwLength);
}

// Constructor: copies default colours first, then overlays new data
ColourTable::ColourTable(ColourTable *defaultColours, PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	// 4J Stu - Default the colours that of the table passed in
	XMemCpy((void*)m_colourValues, (void*)defaultColours->m_colourValues, sizeof(int) * eMinecraftColour_COUNT);
	loadColoursFromData(pbData, dwLength);
}

// Load colour entries from binary stream
void ColourTable::loadColoursFromData(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	byteArray src(pbData, dwLength);
	ByteArrayInputStream bais(src);
	DataInputStream dis(&bais);

	int versionNumber = dis.readInt();
	int numColours = dis.readInt();

	for (int i = 0; i < numColours; ++i)
	{
		std::wstring colourId = dis.readUTF();
		int colourValue = dis.readInt();
		setColour(colourId, colourValue);

		auto it = s_colourNamesMap.find(colourId);
	}

	bais.reset();
}

// Set a colour by name using integer value
void ColourTable::setColour(const std::wstring& colourName, int value)
{
	auto it = s_colourNamesMap.find(colourName);
	if (it != s_colourNamesMap.end())
	{
		m_colourValues[static_cast<int>(it->second)] = value;
	}
}

// Set a colour by name using hex string (e.g., "#FF0000")
void ColourTable::setColour(const std::wstring& colourName, const std::wstring& value)
{
	setColour(colourName, _fromHEXString<int>(value));
}

// Retrieve colour value by enum ID
unsigned int ColourTable::getColour(eMinecraftColour id)
{
	return m_colourValues[static_cast<int>(id)];
}

#include "function/resources/AssetDatabase/AssetDatabase.h"

#include <pybind11/pybind11.h>
#include <pybind11/stl.h>

namespace py = pybind11;

namespace infengine
{
void RegisterAssetDatabaseBindings(py::module_ &module)
{
    py::class_<AssetDatabase>(module, "AssetDatabase")
        .def(py::init<>())
        .def("initialize", &AssetDatabase::Initialize, py::arg("root_dir"),
             "Set up the asset database using the project root directory")
        .def("refresh", &AssetDatabase::Refresh, "Scan the Assets folder and update the asset list")
        .def("import_asset", &AssetDatabase::ImportAsset, py::arg("filepath"), "Add a new asset to the database")
        .def("delete_asset", &AssetDatabase::DeleteAsset, py::arg("filepath"), "Remove an asset and its metadata")
        .def("move_asset", &AssetDatabase::MoveAsset, py::arg("old_filepath"), py::arg("new_filepath"),
             "Rename or relocate an asset while keeping its GUID intact")
        .def("on_asset_created", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetCreated, py::arg("filepath"), 
             "Callback for file watcher: new asset created")
        .def("on_asset_modified", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetModified, py::arg("filepath"), 
             "Callback for file watcher: existing asset changed")
        .def("on_asset_deleted", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetDeleted, py::arg("filepath"), 
             "Callback for file watcher: asset removed")
        .def("on_asset_moved", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetMoved, py::arg("old_filepath"), py::arg("new_filepath"),
             "Callback for file watcher: asset relocated")
        .def("contains_guid", &AssetDatabase::ContainsGuid, py::arg("guid"), "Verify if a GUID is present")
        .def("contains_path", &AssetDatabase::ContainsPath, py::arg("filepath"), "Verify if a path is registered")
        .def("get_guid_from_path", &AssetDatabase::GetGuidFromPath, py::arg("filepath"), "Retrieve GUID from asset path")
        .def("get_path_from_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetPathFromGuid, py::arg("guid"), "Retrieve asset path from GUID")
        .def("get_meta_by_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByGuid, py::arg("guid"), py::return_value_policy::reference,
             "Fetch metadata using GUID")
        .def("get_meta_by_path", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByPath, py::arg("filepath"), py::return_value_policy::reference,
             "Fetch metadata using asset path")
        .def("get_all_guids", &AssetDatabase::GetAllGuids, "Return all registered GUIDs")
        .def("is_asset_path", &AssetDatabase::IsAssetPath, py::arg("filepath"), "Check if path lies within Assets folder")
        .def_property_readonly("project_root", &AssetDatabase::GetProjectRoot, "Return the project root directory")
        .def_property_readonly("assets_root", &AssetDatabase::GetAssetsRoot, "Return the assets directory path");
}

Eigen::Vector4i html_color(COLORNAME color) {
  const auto& rgb = html_color_bytes[static_cast<size_t>(color)];
  return Eigen::Vector4i(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 255);

// Return color as 4D float vector (normalized to [0,1])
Eigen::Vector4f html_colorf(COLORNAME color) {
  return html_color(color).cast<float>() / 255.0f;
}

// Return reference to the array of color names
const std::array<const char*, static_cast<size_t>(COLORNAME::NUM_COLORNAMES)>& html_color_names() {
  return html_color_names_cstr;
}

// Return just the RGB bytes for a given color
std::array<unsigned char, 3> html_color_value(COLORNAME color) {
  return html_color_bytes[static_cast<size_t>(color)];
}

// Calculate combined attenuation using key velocity lookup
void __SYNSetupVolume(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    ASSERTLINE(85, voice);
    s32 velocityFactor = __SYNVolumeAttenuation[voice->keyVel];
    s32 regionAttn = voice->region->attn;
    voice->attn = regionAttn + velocityFactor;
}

// Determine panning based on MIDI channel assignment
void __SYNSetupPan(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    ASSERTLINE(98, voice);
    if (voice->midiChannel == 9) {
        // Drum channel uses articulation pan setting
        voice->pan = voice->art->pan;
    } else {
        // Regular channels use controller value for pan
        voice->pan = voice->synth->controller[voice->midiChannel][10];
    }
}

// Compute total voice input level by combining multiple attenuation factors
s32 __SYNGetVoiceInput(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    s32 totalAttn = voice->attn + voice->lfoAttn + voice->veAttn;
    return totalAttn >> 0x10;
}

// Calculate fader level from channel-specific and master volume controls
s32 __SYNGetVoiceFader(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    s32 volComp = voice->synth->volAttn[voice->midiChannel];
    s32 expComp = voice->synth->expAttn[voice->midiChannel];
    s32 masterComp = voice->synth->masterVolume;
    return (volComp + expComp + masterComp) >> 0x10;
}

// Configure audio mixing parameters for the voice
void __SYNUpdateMix(SYNVOICE* voice) {
    MIXSetInput(voice->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceInput(voice));
    MIXSetAuxA(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->auxAAttn[voice->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetAuxB(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->auxBAttn[voice->midiChannel] >> 0x10);
    MIXSetFader(voice->axvpb, __SYNGetVoiceFader(voice));
    
    // Only set pan for non-drum channels
    if (voice->midiChannel != 9) {
        MIXSetPan(voice->axvpb, voice->synth->controller[voice->midiChannel][10]);
    }
}

void nseel_asm_1pdd(void)
{
  __asm__(
    FUNCTION_MARKER
     
    "pushl %edi\n"
    "movl $0xfefefefe, %edi\n" 
    "subl $16, %esp\n"
    "fstpl (%esp)\n"
    "call *%edi\n" 
    "addl $16, %esp\n"
    "popl %edi\n"
    FUNCTION_MARKER
     
  );
}

void nseel_asm_2pdd(void)
{
  __asm__(
    FUNCTION_MARKER
    
    "pushl %edi\n"
    "movl $0xfefefefe, %edi\n"
    "subl $16, %esp\n"
    "fstpl 8(%esp)\n"
    "fstpl (%esp)\n"
    "call *%edi\n"
    "addl $16, %esp\n"
    "popl %edi\n"
    
    FUNCTION_MARKER
  );
}

void nseel_asm_2pdds(void)
{
  __asm__(
    FUNCTION_MARKER
    
    "pushl %eax\n"
    "pushl %edi\n"
    "movl $0xfefefefe, %eax\n"
    "subl $8, %esp\n"
    "fstpl (%esp)\n"
    "pushl 4(%edi)\n" /* push parameter */
    "pushl (%edi)\n"    /* push the rest of the parameter */
    "call *%eax\n"
    "addl $16, %esp\n"
    "fstpl (%edi)\n" /* store result */
    "movl %edi, %eax\n" /* set return value */
    // denormal-fix result (this is only currently used for pow_op, so we want this!)
    "movl 4(%edi), %edx\n"
    "addl $0x00100000, %edx\n"
    "andl $0x7FF00000, %edx\n"
    "cmpl $0x00200000, %edx\n"
    "jg 0f\n"
      "xorl %edx, %edx\n"
      "movl %edx, (%edi)\n"
      "movl %edx, 4(%edi)\n"
    "0:\n"
    "popl %edi\n"
    "popl %eax\n"
    FUNCTION_MARKER
    
  );
}

// Refactored static constructor using range-based for loop and emplace
void ColourTable::staticCtor()
{
	for (size_t idx = 0; idx < eMinecraftColour_COUNT; ++idx)
	{
		s_colourNamesMap.emplace(s_colourNamesArray[idx], static_cast<eMinecraftColour>(idx));
	}
}

// Constructor: raw data only
ColourTable::ColourTable(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	initialiseFromStream(pbData, dwLength);
}

// Constructor: with fallback/default table
ColourTable::ColourTable(ColourTable* defaultColours, PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	if (defaultColours != nullptr)
	{
		std::copy_n(defaultColours->m_colourValues, eMinecraftColour_COUNT, m_colourValues);
	}
	else
	{
		std::fill_n(m_colourValues, eMinecraftColour_COUNT, 0);
	}
	initialiseFromStream(pbData, dwLength);
}

// Helper to centralize stream loading logic
void ColourTable::initialiseFromStream(PBYTE pbData, DWORD dwLength)
{
	byteArray sourceBuffer(pbData, dwLength);
	ByteArrayInputStream inputStream(sourceBuffer);
	DataInputStream reader(&inputStream);

	int fileVersion = reader.readInt();
	int colourCount = reader.readInt();

	for (int i = 0; i < colourCount; ++i)
	{
		std::wstring id = reader.readUTF();
		int value = reader.readInt();
		assignColour(id, value);
	}

	inputStream.reset();
}

// Overloaded setter using integer directly
void ColourTable::assignColour(const std::wstring& name, int value)
{
	auto it = s_colourNamesMap.find(name);
	if (it != s_colourNamesMap.end())
	{
		m_colourValues[static_cast<int>(it->second)] = value;
	}
}

// Overloaded setter using hex string
void ColourTable::assignColour(const std::wstring& name, const std::wstring& hexValue)
{
	int decodedValue = _fromHEXString<int>(hexValue);
	assignColour(name, decodedValue);
}

// Getter by enum ID
unsigned int ColourTable::get(eMinecraftColour id) const
{
	return static_cast<unsigned int>(m_colourValues[static_cast<int>(id)]);
}

#include "function/resources/AssetDatabase/AssetDatabase.h"

#include <pybind11/pybind11.h>
#include <pybind11/stl.h>

namespace py = pybind11;

namespace infengine
{
    void RegisterAssetDatabaseBindings(py::module_ &m)
    {
        // Expose AssetDatabase class to Python
        py::class_<AssetDatabase>(m, "AssetDatabase")
            .def(py::init<>())
            
            // Core initialization and refresh methods
            .def("initialize", &AssetDatabase::Initialize, 
                 py::arg("project_root"),
                 "Set up the asset database using the specified project root directory")
            
            .def("refresh", &AssetDatabase::Refresh,
                 "Scan the Assets folder and update the internal asset registry")
            
            // Asset management operations
            .def("import_asset", &AssetDatabase::ImportAsset, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Add a new asset to the database by importing it from the given path")
            
            .def("delete_asset", &AssetDatabase::DeleteAsset, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Remove an asset and its associated metadata from the database")
            
            .def("move_asset", &AssetDatabase::MoveAsset, 
                 py::arg("old_path"), py::arg("new_path"),
                 "Rename or relocate an asset while preserving its unique identifier (GUID)")
            
            // File system event handlers (for integration with file watchers)
            .def("on_asset_created", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetCreated, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Handle notification that a new asset has been created")
            
            .def("on_asset_modified", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetModified, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Handle notification that an existing asset has been modified")
            
            .def("on_asset_deleted", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetDeleted, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Handle notification that an asset has been deleted")
            
            .def("on_asset_moved", &AssetDatabase::OnAssetMoved, 
                 py::arg("old_path"), py::arg("new_path"),
                 "Handle notification that an asset has been moved or renamed")
            
            // Lookup and query operations
            .def("contains_guid", &AssetDatabase::ContainsGuid, 
                 py::arg("guid"), 
                 "Determine whether the specified GUID exists in the database")
            
            .def("contains_path", &AssetDatabase::ContainsPath, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Check if the given path corresponds to a registered asset")
            
            .def("get_guid_from_path", &AssetDatabase::GetGuidFromPath, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Retrieve the GUID associated with a specific asset path")
            
            .def("get_path_from_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetPathFromGuid, 
                 py::arg("guid"), 
                 "Find the asset path corresponding to the given GUID")
            
            .def("get_meta_by_guid", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByGuid, 
                 py::arg("guid"), 
                 py::return_value_policy::reference,
                 "Fetch metadata for an asset identified by its GUID")
            
            .def("get_meta_by_path", &AssetDatabase::GetMetaByPath, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 py::return_value_policy::reference,
                 "Fetch metadata for an asset identified by its path")
            
            .def("get_all_guids", &AssetDatabase::GetAllGuids,
                 "Return a collection of all GUIDs currently stored in the database")
            
            .def("is_asset_path", &AssetDatabase::IsAssetPath, 
                 py::arg("path"), 
                 "Verify whether the provided path lies within the assets directory")
            
            // Read-only properties
            .def_property_readonly("project_root", &AssetDatabase::GetProjectRoot,
                                 "Return the configured root directory for the project")
            
            .def_property_readonly("assets_root", &AssetDatabase::GetAssetsRoot,
                                 "Return the designated root directory for assets");
    }
} // namespace infengine
